_about: Player abilities: what the spell bar and spellbook show, and the numbers each one runs on.

abilities.name: Attack
abilities.desc: Auto attack. Swing at your target each time your weapon is ready, until it falls or you pick another. Right-clicking an enemy starts it too; press again to stop. Off the global cooldown.

abilities.name: Shield Break
abilities.desc: A close-range blow that strikes everything around you and interrupts ordinary attacks. Triggers the global cooldown.

abilities.name: Lunge
abilities.desc: Charge at the enemy you are aiming at and strike on arrival. Triggers the global cooldown.

abilities.name: Brace
abilities.desc: Raise your shield: the next blow within 2.5 seconds, even a Grave Slam, is turned aside. The Warden's defensive ability. 7 second cooldown.

abilities.name: Healing draught
abilities.desc: Drink a healing draught from your bags.
